episodes.synopsis: Yuuri and Chito make it out of the dark cavern on their Kettenkrad but what will they find on the outside?
episodes.title: Starry Sky / War

episodes.synopsis: Yuuri and Chito make their way through snow packed plains and begin to freeze. Will they be offered a reprieve from the cold?
episodes.title: Bath / Journal / Laundry

episodes.synopsis: Yuuri and Chito meet another person after he almost accidentally kills them. Will they help him with his request?
episodes.title: Encounter / City / Streetlights

episodes.synopsis: Chito and Yuuri are fixated on using their photograph machine, but they can't seem to get it to work. As they travel, they find a long forgotten temple.
episodes.title: Photograph / Temple

episodes.synopsis: The girls continue to explore the ruins and they come across a house. Meanwhile, they take a nap which triggers some strange dreams.
episodes.title: House / Nap / The Sound of Rain

episodes.synopsis: An odd person with some ambitious goals enters into Chito and Yuuri's journey. She is willing to help them but only if they will help her in return.
episodes.title: Accident / Technology / Takeoff

episodes.synopsis: Stuck in a labyrinth of pipes, the girls struggle to find their way out. Meanwhile, they look to make some food for themselves. What do they come up with?
episodes.title: Labyrinth / Cooking

episodes.synopsis: The girls continue their journey as they venture into the unknown. With heartfelt conversations, they find out more than they bargained for.
episodes.title: Memories / Spiral / Moonlight

episodes.synopsis: The girls end up in a new facility where they meet a maintenance robot. With a fish and a lonely robot, they find the meaning of what it means for something to be alive.
episodes.title: Technology / Aquarium / Life

episodes.synopsis: Yuuri and Chito explore the ruins of an old town and are left puzzled with the little relics that are left behind.
episodes.title: Train / Wavelength / Capture

episodes.synopsis: As they continue their exploration, the girls run into some interesting creatures, and are left wandering an old weapons facility.
episodes.title: Culture / Destruction / The Past

episodes.synopsis: The girls discuss their realization of loneliness but still have dreams of getting to the next level with an aspiration of reaching the moon one day.
episodes.title: Connection / Friends
